meta.origin: 40 new synthetic policy questions + 6 controls; AI-authored and source-labelled against the existing source corpus. One annotator, not independently human reviewed; no real student logs.
meta.scope: Stratified policy/curriculum topics in the existing KB; paraphrases of known policies, not unseen policy documents.
meta.selection_policy: Do not train, select parameters, edit questions or change gold using predictions on this file. Report failures unchanged.
